title: University enrolment
goal: Show the entities and crow's-foot relationships for university course enrolment.

rubric.must: Enrolment visibly connects Student and Section as the registration bridge.
Course visibly has a one-to-many offers relationship to Section.
Section visibly relates to both an Instructor and a Term.
Department visibly relates to its Courses and Instructors.
The visible entity fields mark primary and foreign keys.
Student, Enrolment, Course, Section, Instructor, Department, and Term are readable entities.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the erd exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target faithfully shows all seven university enrolment entities, their listed fields and PK/FK roles, and seven readable, traceable crow's-foot relationships with coherent one-to-zero-or-many cardinalities. No material overlaps or cropping are visible.

items.evidence: ENROLMENT visibly bridges STUDENT and SECTION through the labeled relationships “registers” and “receives”; student_id and section_id are marked FK.
COURSE connects to SECTION via the readable “offers” relationship, with exactly one COURSE and zero-or-many SECTIONs.
SECTION visibly connects to INSTRUCTOR through “teaches” and TERM through “schedules,” with traceable crow's-foot notation.
DEPARTMENT visibly connects to COURSE through “owns” and INSTRUCTOR through “employs.”
Primary keys have blue PK badges and foreign keys have orange FK badges; the markings match the supplied schema.
STUDENT, ENROLMENT, COURSE, SECTION, INSTRUCTOR, DEPARTMENT, and TERM are all present and readable.
